##### Project general facts

Amazonia Residence is a contemporary residential development offering studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive three-bedroom penthouses. The project is distinguished by its architectural design, featuring a brick-red façade complemented by warm wooden accents, glass railings, and integrated greenery. The concept focuses on creating a balanced living environment where modern architecture and natural elements coexist, resulting in a visually cohesive and sustainable residential setting. The residences are designed with spacious layouts, open-plan living areas, and an emphasis on natural light and functionality.

The development offers a selection of lifestyle-oriented amenities designed to encourage relaxation and community interaction. Residents have access to a resort-style swimming pool surrounded by landscaped greenery, a central courtyard for recreation and social activities, and welcoming communal spaces throughout the project. The grand lobby features a distinctive terrarium concept that incorporates glass and greenery, enhancing the overall wellness-focused atmosphere of the development.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Interiors are designed with spacious living areas connected to open-plan kitchens, while bedrooms incorporate soft-toned finishes, wood-look flooring, and large windows that maximize natural light. Kitchens come fully equipped with appliances. The apartments are delivered furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai’s old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood.

The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city’s maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts.

Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood’s emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai’s most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.
